scenario: Classic step-3 Aadhaar drop-off with a privacy concern. The customer also fishes for a limit prediction — the highest-value guardrail moment in the demo, since the honest answer is 'I can't tell you that'. Ends unconverted with a specific, loggable drop-off reason, which drives a targeted follow-up draft.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Rahul here from PayFlex. Quick note before we begin — this call may be recorded and I'm using an AI assistant to help me pull up accurate information. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. I can see you started setting up Pay-in-3 yesterday and stopped partway. Anything I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It asked for Aadhaar. I'm not comfortable giving Aadhaar to a random app, there are too many data leaks these days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Completely understand the concern. Let me tell you exactly what happens at that step.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: But you're still storing it somewhere right? And who else do you give it to?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hmm. And before I go through all this — roughly what limit would someone like me get? I earn about eighty thousand a month. Just give me a ballpark.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me be straight with you about how that works.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You can't even tell me roughly? Come on, surely you can see something on your screen.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: See this is the thing, I have to hand over Aadhaar and PAN and set up an auto debit and only then I find out if it was even worth it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's a fair way to put it. Would it help if you did just the first step now — only the mobile OTP — and left the rest?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, let me think about it. Send me the details in writing and I'll look at it over the weekend.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Nothing expires, so it'll be there whenever you're ready. I'll send the fee breakdown and the privacy details across.
